evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat assertive statement of what the test does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated as settled and load-bearing — 'must not' / 'must produce' performs a declarative the speaker expects others to act on, meeting the decision bar.
